 Documents/Facts/Annexures
 Date : 03-02-2025 This matter was called on for hearing today.

Coram :
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sandeep Mehta

[In Chamber]
 For Petitioner(s): Mr. Bhagwant Deshpande, Adv.
 Dr. R. R. Deshpande, Aor
 For Respondent(s):
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.
Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner/applicant.
2. The petitioner was convicted by the Assistant Sessions Judge-3, Latur for the offences punishable under Section 306 and Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
In appeal, the Additional Sessions Judge, Latur, acquitted the petitioner from the charge under Section 306 IPC.

However,
the conviction and sentence of Reason: 3 years rigorous imprisonment for the offence punishable under Section 498A IPC was affirmed.

3. Aggrieved, the petitioner preferred revision before the High Court of Judicature at Bombay which came to be rejected, whereupon the petitioner is before this Court by way of present special leave petition which has been moved along with an application for exemption from surrendering being IA No. 20381 of 2025.
